## Expertise

- Full-Stack Development: Building modern web applications with React, Next.js, TypeScript, and backend technologies, with attention to performance, usability, and maintainability.
- Software Architecture: Designing modular systems, reusable components, and clear application boundaries to manage complexity and support future development.
- Backend & API Engineering: Working with APIs, relational databases, data modeling, and application logic to build reliable software foundations.
- Automation & Integration: Connecting systems and services through APIs, webhooks, and workflow automation to simplify repetitive processes.
- AI-Assisted Engineering: Exploring the practical application of language models, AI-assisted development, and intelligent automation in modern software workflows.
